description: Head-to-head record between two eSoccer (virtual football, EA FC) players: who wins more, draws, average goals per duel compared with their league, how many duels ended with 3, 4 or 5+ goals, how often both players scored, goals per player, most common score, current streak, the latest duels (with the clubs each one used) and their next scheduled duel. Answers questions like "who usually wins between X and Y", "X vs Y history", "cara a cara", "h2h", "how many goals in X vs Y", "do both usually score", "how did the last X vs Y end", "and in the last month?", "and when X plays with Real Madrid?". Filters: period, last_n (only the latest N duels) and clubs (club1/club2, or clubs_of_last_duel=true to keep only duels with the same clubs as their latest meeting). By default it uses the same window as the Bettrails page: the last 6 months when that leaves at least 10 duels, otherwise the full record. Statistics only: no odds, no betting advice.

club1.description: Only duels where player1 used this club (partial name OK, e.g. "City").

club2.description: Only duels where player2 used this club.

clubs_of_last_duel.description: Only duels with the same clubs both used in their latest meeting.

language.description: Language of the bettrails.com links returned (normally the language of the conversation). Default: es.

last_n.description: Only the latest N duels (applied after the period).

league.description: League. If omitted, the league where they have met most is used. gt = GTLeagues; adriatic = Adriatic League; valhalla = Valhalla League; valkyrie = Valkyrie League; ggleague = GG League; esportsbattle = EsportsBattle; erivals = eRivals; cyberlivearena = Cyber Live Arena; volta = EsportsBattle Volta.

period.description: Time window. auto (default) = like the Bettrails page; all = full record.

player1.description: First player (nickname as on Bettrails, case does not matter).

name: esoccer_head_to_head
title: eSoccer head-to-head
